questions.question: Find the value of ‘a’ using the concept of BODMAS. 42 ÷ 2 + a × 3 − 22 = 8
questions.questionHtml:
Find the value of ‘a’ using the concept of BODMAS.

42 ÷ 2 + a × 3 − 22 = 8
questions.solution:
Given:

42 ÷ 2 + a × 3 − 22 = 8

Concept Used:

Calculation:

⇒ 42 ÷ 2 + a × 3 − 22 = 8

⇒ 21 + a × 3 – 22 = 8

⇒ 21 + 3a – 22 = 8

⇒ 3a – 1 = 8

⇒ 3a = 9

⇒ a = 9 ÷ 3 = 3

Hence, the value of a is 3.

questions.question: Find the value of p from the following. \(\rm 1\frac{2}{3}\div\frac{4}{9}\times\frac{p}{9}=1\frac{1}{4}\times\frac{2}{3}\div\frac{1}{6}\)
questions.questionHtml:
Find the value of p from the following.

\(\rm 1\frac{2}{3}\div\frac{4}{9}\times\frac{p}{9}=1\frac{1}{4}\times\frac{2}{3}\div\frac{1}{6}\)
questions.solution:
Given:- \(\rm 1\frac{2}{3}\div\frac{4}{9}×\frac{p}{9}=1\frac{1}{4}×\frac{2}{3}\div\frac{1}{6}\)

To find:- The value of p

Calculation:- It is given that \(\rm 1\frac{2}{3}\div\frac{4}{9}×\frac{p}{9}=1\frac{1}{4}×\frac{2}{3}\div\frac{1}{6}\),

Solving the Left-hand side,

⇒\(\rm 1\frac{2}{3}\div\frac{4}{9}×\frac{p}{9}\) = \(\rm \frac{5}{3}\div\frac{4}{9}×\frac{p}{9}\)

⇒\(\rm 1\frac{2}{3}\div\frac{4}{9}×\frac{p}{9}\) = \(\rm \frac{5}{3}×\frac{9}{4}×\frac{p}{9}\)

⇒\(\rm 1\frac{2}{3}\div\frac{4}{9}×\frac{p}{9}\) = \(\frac{5p}{12}\)

Solving the Right-hand side,

⇒\(1\frac{1}{4}×\frac{2}{3}\div\frac{1}{6}\) = \(\frac{5}{4}×\frac{2}{3}\div\frac{1}{6}\)

⇒\(1\frac{1}{4}×\frac{2}{3}\div\frac{1}{6}\) = \(\frac{5}{4}×\frac{2}{3}×\frac{6}{1}\)

⇒\(1\frac{1}{4}×\frac{2}{3}\div\frac{1}{6}\) = \(\frac{60}{12}\) = 5

Equating the Left-hand side and right-hand side,

⇒\(\frac{5p}{12}\) = 5

⇒ p = 12

The value of p in the expression is 12

Alternate Method \(\rm 1\frac{2}{3}\div\frac{4}{9}×\frac{p}{9}=1\frac{1}{4}×\frac{2}{3}\div\frac{1}{6}\)

⇒ \(\rm \frac{5}{3}×\frac{9}{4}×\frac{p}{9}=\frac{5}{4}×\frac{2}{3}×6\)

⇒ Solving we get, P = 2 × 6 = 12

questions.question: The marked price of a toy is Rs. 450. After a certain discount on the marked price, the selling price of the toy is Rs. 405. The rate of discount is:
questions.questionHtml: The marked price of a toy is Rs. 450. After a certain discount on the marked price, the selling price of the toy is Rs. 405. The rate of discount is:
questions.solution:
Given:

Marked Price (M.P.) of toy = 450

Selling Price (S.P.) of toy = 405

Formula used:

Discount percentage = [(Marked price – Selling price)/Marked price] × 100

Calculation:

M.P. = 450

S.P. = 405

Discount % = [(450 – 405)/450] × 100

⇒ (45/450) × 100

⇒ 10%

∴ The rate of discount is 10%.

questions.question: Simplify the following expression: \(\frac{108\times108\times108-92\times92\times92}{108\times108+92\times92+108\times92}\)

\(\frac{108\times108\times108-92\times92\times92}{108\times108+92\times92+108\times92}\)
questions.solution:
Given:

\(\frac{108\times108\times108-92\times92\times92}{108\times108+92\times92+108\times92}\)

Formula used:

(a)3 – (b)3 = (a – b)(a2 + b2 + ab)

Calculation:

\(\frac{108\times108\times108-92\times92\times92}{108\times108+92\times92+108\times92}\)

⇒ \(\frac{(108)^3\;-\;(92)^3}{(108)^2\;+\;(92)^2\;+\;108\;\times\;92}\)

⇒ \(\frac{(108\;-\;92)[(108)^2\;+\;(92)^2\;+\;108\;\times\;92]}{(108)^2\;+\;(92)^2\;+\;108\;\times\;92}\)

⇒ 108 – 92

⇒ 16

questions.question: Simplify the expression \(\rm \left(\frac{p}{q}\right)^{10}+\left(\frac{q}{p}\right)^{10} \) if \(\rm \frac{p}{q}+\frac{q}{p}=2\) .
questions.questionHtml: Simplify the expression \(\rm \left(\frac{p}{q}\right)^{10}+\left(\frac{q}{p}\right)^{10} \) if \(\rm \frac{p}{q}+\frac{q}{p}=2\).
questions.solution:
Given:

\(\rm \frac{p}{q}+\frac{q}{p}=2\)

Calculations:

Let \(\frac{p}{q}\) be x.

Then According to question,

\(\rm \frac{p}{q}+\frac{q}{p}=2\)

⇒ x + \(\frac{1}{x}\) = 2

⇒ x2 + 1 = 2x

⇒ (x - 1)2 = 0

So, x = 1

⇒\(\frac{p}{q}\) = 1

So, now 

\(\rm \left(\frac{p}{q}\right)^{10}+\left(\frac{q}{p}\right)^{10} \)

=  (1)10  + (1)10

= 1 + 1

= 2

Hence, The required value is 2.

questions.question: If \(\sqrt{1+\frac{x}{529}}=\frac{24}{23}\) , then the value of x is:
questions.questionHtml: If \(\sqrt{1+\frac{x}{529}}=\frac{24}{23}\), then the value of x is:
questions.solution:
Given:

\(\sqrt{1+\frac{x}{529}}=\frac{24}{23}\)

Calculation:

⇒ Squaring both the sides, we get

⇒ 1 + \(\frac{x}{529}\) = \(\frac{24\times 24}{23\times 23}\)

⇒ \(\frac{529+x}{529}\) = \(\frac{576}{529}\)

⇒ 529 + x = 576

⇒ x = 576 – 529 = 47

Therefore, the value of x is 47.

Using the concept of percentage

Area of square = (Side)2

Calculation:

Let the original side be 10.

Area of original square = (Side)2

⇒ Original area = 102

New side = (100 – 17)% of 10

⇒ New side = 83/100 × 10

⇒ New side = 8.3

New area = (New side)2

⇒ New area = (8.3)2

⇒ New area = 68.89

Percent decrease in area = (Original area – New area)/(Original area) × 100

⇒ Percent decrease in area = (100 – 68.89)/100 × 100

⇒ Percent decrease in area = 31.11%

∴ The percentage decrease in area is 31.11%.

Shortcut TrickDecreasing(%) in area = - x - x + (- x × - x)/100

Decreasing(%) in area = - 17 - 17 + (- 17 × - 17)/100

⇒ - 34 + 2.89 = - 31.11

∴ The percentage decrease in area is 31.11%

\(25 - \left[ {16 - \left\{ {14 - \left( {18 - \overline {8 + 3} } \right)} \right\}} \right]\)

questions.question: If the length of a rectangle is increased by 30% and breadth is reduced by 15%, find the percent change in the area of the rectangle.
questions.questionHtml: If the length of a rectangle is increased by 30% and breadth is reduced by 15%, find the percent change in the area of the rectangle.
questions.solution:
GIVEN:

Length increases by 30%

Breadth reduces by 15% 

FORMULA USED:

Area of  rectangle = Length × Breadth 

CALCULATION:

Let us assume the original length and breadth to be 100 each respectively,

Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth = ( 100 × 100 ) = 10000 

Now, according to the question

Length increases by 30% 

New length = 100 +  100 × 30 / 100 = ( 100 + 30 ) = 130 

Also, breadth reduces by 15%

New breadth = 100 - 100 × 15 /100 =  ( 100 - 15 ) = 85 

New area = new length × new breadth = (130 × 85 ) = 11050 

⇒ Increment in area = ( 11050 - 10000 ) = 1050 

⇒ % increment in area = ( 1050 /10000) × 100 = 10.5%

Hence, there is a 10.5% increment in the area of the rectangle.

Shortcut TrickFormula Used:  A +B +AB/100 

⇒ 30 - 15 - (30× 15)/100 = 15 - 4.5 = 10.5

(Negative sign shows reduce in %)
